query:
SELECT 
  fr.id,
  fr.vessel_id,
  fr.booking_id,
  fr.liters,
  fr.price_per_liter,
  fr.total_cost,
  fr.payment_status,
  fr.created_at,
  v.name as vessel_name
FROM fuel_records fr
LEFT JOIN vessels v ON fr.vessel_id = v.id
WHERE fr.total_cost = 4500
ORDER BY fr.created_at DESC
LIMIT 5;
